description: Drinking Water - Public Water System Annually Reported Water Production and Delivery Information 2013-2022 is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California State Water Resources Control Board. Amount of water produced by month and by source and the water delivered by type of use and by month for every Public Water System (PWS) reporting. Public Water Systems submit their annual inventory information using the electronic Annual Report (eAR) submission process. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California State Water Resources Control Board. Its tags are Drinking Water, Electronic Annual Report, Sources of Drinking Water, Urban Water Produced, Urban Water Reporting. It offers 39 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2024-11-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
